mapBase: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background map for a portrait mobile isometric recycling exploration game. Create a complete landscape 1536x1024 illustration, no UI, no lettering, no characters, no litter, no logos. Art direction: original animated sitcom cartoon world, bold clean dark ink outlines, simple flat-color shapes, warm tasteful pastel colors, subtle cel shadows, detailed charming buildings. Fixed orthographic isometric camera looking down about 40 degrees, no horizon, no perspective vanishing point. CRITICAL GAMEPLAY COMPOSITION: the central and bottom two thirds of the image must be a huge broad unobstructed pale paved public plaza occupying x=20% to 85%, y=40% to 95%. Put tall buildings and scenery along the TOP edge and FAR LEFT and RIGHT edges only. Keep the broad center and bottom open for a moving character, game collectibles and a recycling station. Attractive paving patterns and subtle cracks but no objects in the central plaza. Full bleed world fills entire image, sharp highly polished hand drawn mobile game artwork.
characterPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent character sprite atlas for original mobile recycling game. Landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen equally-sized cells, no gutters between cells, no labels, no cell borders. In EVERY cell one complete identical original young adult male cartoon recycler character with warm tan skin, short dark brown hair, large expressive eyes, rounded nose, a friendly small smile, bold clean black outlines and flat color shapes reminiscent of animated sitcom Family Guy style, completely original identity. Consistent head and body proportions, modestly large head, short compact body, sneakers. Exactly centered in each 384x256 cell; every character feet baseline at 240px within the cell, character from y=16 to y=240 with transparent generous side margins. Columns represent directions: column 1 front facing slightly right (southeast), column 2 back facing slightly right (northeast), column 3 back facing slightly left (northwest), column 4 front facing slightly left (southwest). Rows represent outfits: row 1 teal green short-sleeve shirt and beige trousers; row 2 golden orange work vest over white tee and dark blue trousers; row 3 lavender hoodie and charcoal trousers; row 4 navy blue worker jumpsuit and orange sneakers. Arms resting slightly away from body, full body always visible, feet planted, every cell same scale. Clean truly transparent background including spaces around characters. No ground shadow, no objects, no text. This is an actual uniform game sprite sheet, not a concept sheet.
